name: Prince Edward Island National Park
policyReason: Dogs are allowed on all trails, campgrounds and picnic areas; only the beaches close seasonally.
summary: Leashed dogs can use trails, picnic areas and campgrounds; beaches are closed to pets April 1 to October 15.

excerpts.quote: You can have your dog with you at picnic areas, camping areas, and along the many trails in the Park.
Pets are prohibited on national park beaches from April 1 - October 15 but are still allowed on leash in camping areas, picnic areas and along park trails.

dogRules.text: No pets on any park beach from April 1 to October 15 (piping plovers); minimum fine $100.
Coyotes can be bold toward dogs in winter breeding season.
